notes.title: Update for Anniversary Edition
notes.notes:
We've updated Monster! on Steam to the new 10th Anniversary Edition to celebrate the 10th Anniversary of the game's original release. We thought it would be fun to not only update the engine but also add a bit more polish to the game. The new edition plays similarly from the original version of the game but with some new challenges and surprises.

Here's a list of the changes in this new version:

    
 NEW Level Difficulty Curve - There are now 35 unique levels of Monsters! to fight through.
     NEW Monster Behaviors - A complete rework of Monster behaviors and some new ones added into the mix.
     NEW "Remastered" Sprites - Monsters now come in a variety of vibrant pixelated colors!
     NEW Particle Effects - More Juice!
     NEW HUD Animations - Dragons go ROAR!
     Updated Unity Engine - Support for 64bit Systems and Apple Silicon.


Still in the works but coming soon:

    
 New Chip Tune Soundtrack
     New Promo Art for Stores

notes.title: We Want Your Feedback on a New Version of Monsters!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/113a4358646f958b01d31a78640a395dfcea912b.png

We've been working on some improvements to the game lately. Everyone who has purchased the game will have access to the beta versions going forward. While we've been making some changes to the pixel art and the user interface, our main goal with this beta version is to get some gameplay feedback. 

We could use your help! There have been some significant changes to gameplay with this version. Most notably with the enemy AI and overall flow of the levels. Getting your feedback during the design process would be an immense help. If you do want to help us out, you will have to set up Steam to download the beta for you (see the screenshots). 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/db0404460e615f123ce56e0b453a96589ed86bc8.png http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/65686584a1d427051d2f5af4ba2bc0527ad3f0aa.png

I've created a discussion on the steam forums where players can post their feedback here.

All feedback is helpful so don't hold back. That said, we want to try and keep the feedback focused on if the new level progression, AI behaviors, and other game play feels fun.

I also want to note that we will be keeping the older version available through steam even when we release this newer version. That way folks who really enjoy the older version of the game can keep on enjoying it.

That's it for now.

Cheers!
